items.title: Confounding by deprivation is unresolved
items.whyItMatters: One study's association vanished after adjustment for neighbourhood deprivation (claim c2) while another persisted (claim c1).
items.opportunity: Model deprivation at school and neighbourhood level and report both adjusted estimates.

items.title: No estimate after licensing began in this state
items.whyItMatters: The state study used 2017 data, before licensing.
items.opportunity: Use the 2025 survey and the 2026 licence list.

items.title: Vaping exposure is incompletely licensed
items.whyItMatters: Vape-only retailers may be missing from the licence list.
items.opportunity: Check whether the list covers vape-only retailers and report vaping with that caveat.

items.title: Regional students may differ
items.whyItMatters: Buffers mean different things in towns and the capital.

errorsFound: Treating a cross-sectional association as the effect of a cap would overstate what the analysis can show.
reevaluation: The analysis is worth doing only if deprivation is modelled carefully and results are framed as associations.
summary: Four gaps: unresolved confounding, no post-licensing estimate, incomplete vape exposure, and remoteness.
